column1: # Hotkey binding codec cases. See ../README.md, keys/.
# Modifiers are written Ctrl+Shift+Alt, whatever order they are read in
# Lists keep their order and are joined by comma and space
# Native codes: 0x and one or two hex digits, 0x01 to 0xFE; a named code is written as its name
# Native codes with no name are written in upper-case hex without padding
# A modifier's own code is a key, written in hex
# Native codes that are not codes
# Unity mods read names only: a number has no single meaning across the two dialects
# Unity names with no Windows key code
# A second Unity name for one value reads as the key and is written as its name
